settings.lede: Every ComfortCrest bed is built to standard UK sizes, so your existing mattress and bedding will fit. Here are the numbers, and the room each size really needs.

settings.name: Single
settings.best_for: Children, guest rooms and box rooms

settings.name: Small Double
settings.best_for: One adult with room to spread out, or a snug second bedroom

settings.name: Double
settings.best_for: Two adults in an average UK bedroom

settings.name: King
settings.best_for: Couples who want space, and anyone over six foot

settings.name: Super King
settings.best_for: Master bedrooms, and sleeping undisturbed beside a restless partner

settings.heading: UK bed sizes, in plain numbers
settings.note: Measure your room before you order — allow 70cm at the side you get in and out of, and check the turn at the top of your stairs. If you are unsure, send us the measurements and we will tell you what will fit.

settings.question: What is the difference between a King and a Super King?
settings.answer: 30cm of width. A King is 150cm across, a Super King 180cm. Both are 200cm long. If you share a bed with a restless sleeper, that 30cm is the single best upgrade you can buy.

settings.question: Are UK sizes the same as European or American ones?
settings.answer: No, and the difference is enough to matter. A UK King is 150 × 200cm; a European King is 160 × 200cm and a US King is 193 × 203cm. Bedding bought abroad will not fit a UK bed properly. Measure your mattress before ordering a frame.

settings.question: How much room do I need around the bed?
settings.answer: Allow 70cm on the side you get in and out of, and 50cm on any other free side. For an ottoman bed, also leave room for the base to swing up — check the ceiling height if the bed sits under a slope.

settings.question: Will it get up my stairs?
settings.answer: Almost always, because the frame arrives in sections rather than built. The tight spots are narrow landings and turns at the top of a staircase. Measure the narrowest point and tell us — we will confirm before your bed is made.

settings.heading: Getting the size right
settings.body: The measurements above answer most of it. These cover the rest.
